question: Display the corrected Compass direction and full-library human paired scores without reusing superseded panels.
decision: Provide current shareable figures that preserve units and interpretation limits.
strongest_rival: A plotted title, sign, scale or denominator could repeat the superseded interpretation.
discriminator: Show the raw-penalty sign beside corrected consistency and all ten paired donor differences for both human score arms.
exposure_record: Fully exposed rendering of completed correction outputs. No new biological analysis or hypothesis test.
biological_unit: Panel A computational micropools nested in four libraries and two animals; panel B ten paired donors.
nesting_and_overlap: The two panels use different source cohorts; each reuses its underlying correction run, not independent replication.
population_and_selection: Same named PGM_pos and PGCD_pos reactions and all ten paired human donors; no outcome-based selection.
contrast: Penalty versus consistency correlation; paired donor CSF-minus-blood score for authors inflammatory and regulatory modules.
endpoint: One plate as PNG at 300 dpi, PDF and SVG, plus a manifest recording input and output hashes.
methods: Matplotlib layout from frozen source tables. The donor differences are direct display arithmetic; the median bars come from saved paired_tissue.csv. No new testing.
missingness_and_exclusions: Only donors with both CSF and blood appear, ten of twelve. Reaction p values describe pools, not animal replication.
multiplicity: No test is performed; the BH values shown are the source run's own.
precision_basis: No interval is drawn except the source run's matched random-set interval.
interpretation_limit: RNA-derived scores, not measured flux, protein, lineage or causal effect. No regulatory equivalence; modern substituted Compass inputs are not a reproduction of published Figure 1.
stop_rule: Render the plate as specified. Do not drop a category, change an axis range or soften a title after seeing the rendering; if a title is contradicted by its own axis, the title is corrected.
amendment_reason: Replace only the affected Compass/human panels using versioned corrected runs; retain the historical six-plate package.
